label: MOTD
description: Message of the day management, shown to players on connect.

commands.name: setmotd
commands.description: Sets the message of the day for this server.

commands.name: setmotdall
commands.description: Sets the message of the day for all servers.

commands.name: getmotd
commands.description: Shows the current message of the day for this server.

commands.name: clearmotd
commands.description: Clears the message of the day on this server.

commands.name: clearmotdall
commands.description: Clears the message of the day on all servers.

commands.name: addmotd
commands.description: Appends text to the existing message of the day on this server.

commands.name: addmotdall
commands.description: Appends text to the existing message of the day on all servers.

cvars.label: MOTD Sound
cvars.description: Sound file played when the MOTD is shown.

cvars.label: MOTD Header
cvars.description: Header text shown above the message of the day.
